prompt: Create a finished 16:9 full-frame handmade paper/card diorama thumbnail. A single worker in period-appropriate plain clothing stands beside a waist-high paper wall made from three full sections and one clearly missing section; a small wage coin cannot bridge the final gap to a loaf and candle on the other side. Large dimensional rounded cut-paper words read exactly “333 DAYS?” The composition must make the question and shortfall instantly clear: face and extended hand point toward the missing section; a narrow beam of warm light catches the bread while the worker remains readable. Layered paper fibers, torn edges, physical shadows, restrained ochre and midnight blue, no extra text, no modern props, no photographic realism.
visual_intent: A model-implied wage-day shortfall before the Black Death: the annual earnings cover about three quarters of the reconstructed basic-needs basket, requiring roughly 333 modeled wage-days against an assumed 250. At small size, the incomplete wall, coin and essentials must stay distinct; the title supplies the household-basics context.
